review_text: App crashes every time I try to download playlists for offline listening. So frustrating.
Why can't I rearrange songs in a playlist anymore? The UI update made this impossible.
Constantly skipping songs randomly. Premium user paying for this.
The shuffle feature is not random. It plays the same 20 songs.
Search has gotten so bad. I can't find songs I literally just listened to.
DJ feature is amazing, makes discovering new music actually fun again.
Why does Spotify use so much battery on iOS? Drains my phone.
Wrapped is the only reason I keep my subscription tbh
Audiobooks taking over the app and I never use them. Give me back music focus.
Lyrics are out of sync constantly. Was working fine a year ago.
Playback stops randomly when I lock my phone. Happens 10x a day.
Can't queue songs from search results anymore on android. Major regression.
I love that you can pin folders now. Finally.
Spotify Connect to my Sonos keeps disconnecting. Used to work flawlessly.
Why are podcasts mixed into my music recommendations? I don't want podcasts.
The new home screen is cluttered. Too many sections I don't need.
Offline songs disappear randomly. Have to redownload constantly.
Cannot for the life of me figure out how to delete a playlist on the new UI.
Discover Weekly is no longer good. Used to be the best feature.
Songs skip and stutter on slow connections instead of buffering.
Why is there an ad after every 2 songs now on free tier?
I miss the social features. Friend activity sidebar was useful.
Account got hacked twice this year. Security is a joke.
Can't transfer playback between devices smoothly anymore.
Algorithm keeps suggesting songs I've explicitly disliked. What's the point.
Family plan management is hidden in 4 menus. Make it obvious.
The audiobook hours never refresh on time. Customer support is useless.
App is way more responsive on Android after the latest update. Thank you.
Why removed the timer for sleep? I used it every night.
Equalizer settings reset every time I close the app on iPhone.
Adding to queue is now buried under 3 taps. Used to be a long press.
AI playlist generator is decent but ignores half my prompts.
The price hike came with no improvements. Where's the value.
Can we please get a real volume normalization option that actually works.
Connection to car bluetooth drops every time I get a notification.
Liked Songs limit is finally gone, this is huge.
Hate that I can't see album art on the lock screen sometimes.
Refunds are impossible to get when you cancel mid-cycle.
Why is the desktop app so much worse than the web player?
Suggested songs after my playlist ends are way off topic.
My downloaded songs work even with no signal which is the only reason I pay.
Volume controls don't work with my AirPods after iOS 18 update.
Can't share songs to Instagram stories properly anymore.
The 'made for you' section is just the same 5 playlists every week.
Why does it take 30 seconds to open the app on android?
Genuinely the best discovery tool out there still, despite the gripes.
Spotify connect to my smart TV is broken for 2 months now.
Hate the new way notifications work. Can't dismiss them properly.
Crossfade between songs is shorter than I set it. Bug.
I want my old library view back. The new grid is bad.
Login from a new device requires too many verification steps now.
